claims.text: Anthropic's Aug 14 article states future Claude models will generate text containing a watermark to estimate likelihood of Claude involvement, implemented with other major providers for EU AI Act compliance.
The article states the method uses token-choice watermarking with no practical impact on output quality and no reader-distinguishable difference.
